title: My scores
subtitle: Log your score for each day and mode and follow your gains and losses by day, week and season.

help.text1: Fill in each mode's score on the game day (the day turns at 12:00). Since BA resets every 28 days, each day and week is compared with the same day and week last month: green is up, red is down.
help.text2: Saved on this device and, if you sign in, in your account too. Only you can see your scores.
help.text3: On reset day (Thursday, Days 1, 8, 15 and 22), log twice: what you scored before 22:00 counts for the week that ends; after 22:00 the score restarts and counts for the new week.
help.text4: Normal BA: no need to log it. It's worth 166,750 and 210,500, alternating on each week's BAX/BAL days (there's none on BAI days), and it's added to the total as soon as you log your BAX or BAL. On reset day it's played again, so it counts before and after 22:00.

locked.title: Unlocks today at 22:00
locked.text: Scores start counting at today's weekly reset (10/22, 22:00 Brasília time), so every day, week and season adds up correctly.

cards.todayFooter: Vs. the same cycle day last month
cards.weekFooter: So far, vs. the same week last month up to the same day

entry.title: Log score
entry.subtitle: Pick the day and write how much you scored in each mode. Saves when you leave the field; clearing the number removes it.
entry.invalid: Numbers only (you can use separators for thousands).
entry.noTeam: You haven't built a team for this day.
entry.normalPending: from normal BA: added to the total once you log your BAX or BAL
entry.normalCounted_one: from normal BA, already added to the day's total
entry.normalCounted_other: from normal BA (before and after reset), already added to the day's total

chart.title: Performance
chart.subtitle: BA resets every 28 days: each day and week is compared with the same day and week last month.
chart.empty: Log a day's score to see the charts.

compare.growthTitle: Growth vs. the same day last month (green up, red down)
compare.growthTitleWeek: Growth vs. the same week last month (green up, red down)
compare.noPrevious: No score in the same period last month

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Everything you logged, each vs. the same day and mode last month. Tap a row to edit that day.
